title: Fosters Needed
intro: These pups need a foster home, and some of them can't wait. Tap Apply on any dog to help.

dogs.name: Prim
dogs.bio: Prim is a smart, gentle puppy who learns fast and loves couch cuddles, blankets and playtime. She must be fostered in a home with another dog.

dogs.name: Maude Ivory
dogs.bio: Maude Ivory is a quiet, sweet girl who loves sofa naps and long walks. She never barks, is great on leash and is almost house trained.

dogs.name: Haymitch
tags: With Gale or a dog buddy
dogs.bio: Haymitch is a clever, cuddly puppy who already knows sit, down, come and crate. He needs to be fostered with his brother Gale or in a home with another dog.

dogs.name: Gale
tags: With Haymitch or a dog buddy
dogs.bio: Gale is a calm, goofy cuddle bug who loves sleeping on your shoulder and is very quiet. He needs to be fostered with his brother Haymitch or in a home with another dog.
